title.narrative: Gleichberechtigung in der Technologie fördert den Klimaschutz

description.narrative: Mit diesem Projekt trägt das Netzwerk Women Engage for a Common Future (WECF) zur Umsetzung der Gleichstellungsziele des UN Climate Technology Centre and Network (CTCN) bei. CTCN wiederum zielt darauf ab, den Transfer und Einsatz umweltfreundlicher Technologien für den Klimaschutz in den Ländern des Globalen Südens zu beschleunigen. Das Projekt zielt darauf ab, sicherzustellen, dass Frauen in all ihrer Diversität in Ländern des Globalen Südens gleichermaßen an der Entwicklung, dem Transfer und der Nutzung von Klimatechnologien beteiligt sind.

The project aims to ensure that women, in all their diversity, participate equally in the devel-opment, transfer, and use of climate technologies in countries of the Global South. By embedding gender-responsive approaches into national support measures (technical as-sistance), the project contributes to increasing the ambition and inclusive planning and im-plementation of national climate policies. The measure aims to align policy frameworks even more closely with local community realities, ensuring that climate technologies are not only technically sound but also socially relevant, inclusive, and accepted by local communities. Sector-specific guidelines for gender-responsive technologies will be developed through consultations, workshops, and mentoring programs. Institutional capacity and accountability among CTCN implementers and stakeholders will be increased to ensure the application of gender-responsive budgeting and monitoring tools. This, in turn, is intended to lead to a more transparent and effective allocation of funds for gender equality activities. To this end, the project supports the implementation and review of the CTCN Gender Policy and Action Plan (GAP) and advocates for at least 5% of support services to be explicitly used for gender mainstreaming.
